## Company Overview / 公司概况
**English:**
- SKEQI was established in 2012 as a high-tech enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment. **[Verified]** [3][6].
- The Shanghai parent entity operates under a registered capital of 65.178 million RMB, while the Ningde subsidiary holds a registered capital of 100 million RMB. **[Verified]** [2][6].
- The company employs approximately 2,000 personnel, with platform listings indicating an organizational scale of 1,000–5,000 employees. **[Verified]** [3][4].
- Manufacturing operations are distributed across four bases: Ningde Jiaocheng, Ningde Dongqiao, Shanghai Songjiang, and Dalian Beihai. **[Verified]** [3].
- A new 260,000-square-meter Phase II manufacturing base in Ningde is gradually entering production to boost capacity and delivery speed. **[Verified]** [1].
- The corporate headquarters and primary registered address are located in Jiaocheng District, Ningde City, Fujian Province. **[Verified]** [1][4].

**中文：**
- 思客琦成立于2012年，是一家专业从事智能装备研发、生产与销售的高新技术企业。 **[Verified]** [3][6]。
- 上海主体公司注册资本为6517.8万人民币，宁德子公司注册资本为1亿人民币。 **[Verified]** [2][6]。
- 公司员工规模近2000人，就业平台登记显示企业总规模为1000-5000人。 **[Verified]** [3][4]。
- 制造基地分布于宁德蕉城、宁德东侨、上海松江和大连北海四大园区。 **[Verified]** [3]。
- 位于福建宁德的二期智造基地面积达26万㎡，正逐步投产以提升产能与交付效率。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 公司总部及注册地址设于福建省宁德市蕉城区疏港路115号。 **[Verified]** [1][4]。

## Core Business / 核心业务
**English:**
- The company’s core focus is delivering comprehensive intelligent manufacturing solutions anchored in intelligent equipment. **[Verified]** [1][3].
- Primary operations specialize in deep-tier integration for the new energy sector, encompassing equipment manufacturing, digital factory management, and industrial software/services. **[Verified]** [1].
- Supportive business units extend into precision manufacturing, laser application technology, and industrial non-destructive testing to broaden industrial client coverage. **[Verified]** [1].

**中文：**
- 公司的核心聚焦于提供以智能装备为基础的智能制造整体解决方案。 **[Verified]** [1][3]。
- 主营业务深度聚焦新能源赛道，涵盖新能源设备制造、产线集成、数字工厂管理系统及工业软件服务。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 配套业务板块延伸至精密制造、激光应用技术与工业无损检测，以支撑更广泛的工业制造客户需求。 **[Verified]** [1]。

## Products & Services / 产品与服务
**English:**
- New Energy Intelligent Equipment covers complete workflows including cell assembly, module formation, PACK encapsulation, and battery recycling/disassembly. **[Verified]** [1][3].
- The QIHANG Digital Factory System is a proprietary 5G-powered industrial management suite integrating WMS, MES, supply chain control, and big-data visualization dashboards. **[Verified]** [1].
- COPPER (科派乐) Intelligent Logistics provides end-to-end smart conveyance, automated handling, and warehousing solutions driven by non-standard automation. **[Verified]** [1].
- Laser Application Technology delivers one-stop industrial solutions centered on laser welding, laser energy control, and laser beam shaping. **[Verified]** [1].
- Industrial NDT supplies high-end 2D/3D X-ray smart inspection equipment and tailored solutions. **[Verified]** [1].
- Precision Manufacturing handles custom industrial parts, molds, plastic/hardware accessories, and battery components. **[Verified]** [1].
- Automotive & Components segment offers flexible, automated, and intelligent production lines specifically for body-in-white and chassis welding applications. **[Verified]** [1].

**中文：**
- 新能源智能装备覆盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装及电池回收拆解等完整工艺链条。 **[Verified]** [1][3]。
- 琦航数字工厂系统是自主研发的5G赋能工业管理系统，深度融合WMS仓储管理、MES生产执行、供应链管控及大数据可视化看板。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 科派乐智能物流以智能输送系统为核心，结合智能搬运、智慧仓储及非标自动化系统提供一体化解决方案。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 激光应用技术聚焦三大核心技术（激光焊接、激光能量控制、激光整形），提供面向多行业的一站式方案。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 工业无损检测设备提供高端（2D/3D）X射线智能检测硬件及配套解决方案。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 精密制造业务包含工业零部件、模具、精密塑胶、塑胶及五金配件、电池部件的研发设计生产。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 汽车与零部件板块专注车身白车身、底盘件及相关焊接装备的柔性化、自动化智能产线服务。 **[Verified]** [1]。

## Industries Served / 服务行业
**English:**
- SKEQI actively serves the new energy battery manufacturing, automotive & components, electronic semiconductors, photovoltaic & energy storage, aerospace, and special vehicle industries. **[Verified]** [1][3][5].

**中文：**
- 思客琦的业务广泛服务于新能源电池制造、汽车及零部件、电子半导体、光伏与储能、航空航天以及特种车辆行业。 **[Verified]** [1][3][5]。

## Customer Segments / 客户类型
**English:**
- Target customer tiers include leading lithium battery producers, mainstream NEV brands, PV/energy storage developers, traditional auto OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, and specialized commercial/special vehicle operators. **[Verified]** [1][3][5].

**中文：**
- 目标客户群体涵盖头部锂电池企业、主流新能源汽车品牌、光伏/储能开发商、传统主机厂及一级供应商，以及特种车辆运营商。 **[Verified]** [1][3][5]。

## Customers & Partners / 客户与合作伙伴
**English:**
- Key clients in the battery and energy storage space include CATL, CALB, EVE Energy, REPT Batteries, Jinko Solar, and Hithium. **[Verified]** [1][3][5].
- Automotive and special vehicle partners span XPeng, Leapmotor, Audi, BMW, Ford, Geely, SAIC, Linde, and Hangcha. **[Verified]** [1][3][5].
- The customer roster is documented through first-party sources (SKEQI official website) [1] and third-party sources (university recruitment notices and job boards) [3][4][5].

**中文：**
- 电池与储能领域的核心客户包括宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源、晶科能源和海辰。 **[Verified]** [1][3][5]。
- 汽车及特种车辆合作伙伴涵盖小鹏、零跑汽车、奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽集团、林德和杭叉。 **[Verified]** [1][3][5]。
- 客户名录来源为第一方资料（思客琦官方网站）[1] 与第三方资料（高校宣讲会及招聘平台）[3][4][5]。

## Differentiators / 差异化优势
**English:**
- SKEQI captured the #1 domestic market share in China for module and PACK production lines in 2023. **[Verified]** [3].
- The company leverages a mature R&D architecture led by the IMATI institute, backed by over 240 authorized patents including recent breakthroughs in cell-stacking positioning hardware. **[Verified]** [2][3].
- Operational advantages feature rapid local response via the expanded 260,000 sqm facility, proven cost-control methodologies, and reliable delivery guarantees. **[Verified]** [1].
- Commercial reach extends internationally, with active project deployments across Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America. **[Verified]** [3].

**中文：**
- 思客琦在2023年斩获国内模组及PACK生产线市场占有率第一的成绩。 **[Verified]** [3]。
- 公司依托IMATI智能制造先进技术研究院构建成熟科创体系，累计拥有超240项授权专利，近期在电芯堆叠定位硬件等方面实现技术突破。 **[Verified]** [2][3]。
- 运营优势体现为26万㎡新基地带来的快速响应能力、卓越的成本控制水平以及稳健的交付保障机制。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 商业布局具备国际化特征，项目已成功拓展至欧洲、东南亚及北美市场。 **[Verified]** [3]。

## Brand Values / 品牌价值观
**English:**
- SKEQI explicitly advocates the core values of “Integrity, Innovation, Responsibility, Gratitude” (诚信 创新 责任 感恩). **[Verified]** [1].
- Brand positioning emphasizes collaborative ecosystem building, technological leapfrogging, and energy-efficiency optimization to drive sustainable new energy manufacturing. **[Verified]** [1].
- External validation through industry awards (e.g., CATL “Best Equipment Quality Response Award”, multiple GGII annual honors) reinforces a brand identity rooted in quality assurance and service excellence. **[Verified]** [1][3].

**中文：**
- 思客琦明确倡导“诚信 创新 责任 感恩”的核心价值观。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 品牌定位强调协同共建能源装备智造新生态、推动技术跃迁以及以能效提升助力新能源产业可持续发展。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 外部认可（如宁德时代「最佳设备质量响应奖」、多项高工锂电/储能年度奖项）进一步印证了其以质量筑基、以服务致胜的品牌主张。 **[Verified]** [1][3]。

## Recent Developments / 近期动态
**English:**
- On December 9, SKEQI delivered a keynote presentation on “Energy Storage Manufacturing Energy Efficiency Improvement Path” at the GGII conference. **[Verified]** [1].
- In November 2024, the company received the GGII 15th Anniversary Special Award for “15-Year Technology Leap”. **[Verified]** [1][3].
- An August 2025 patent authorization (CN224662069U) was granted for a taped cell pre-stacking secondary positioning slide table technology. **[Verified]** [2].
- The organization is actively executing its 2026 campus recruitment campaign, targeting mechanical, electrical, process, vision, algorithm, and management trainee positions. **[Verified]** [3][5].

**中文：**
- 12月9日，思客琦在高工储能年会发表题为“储能制造能效提升路径”的主题演讲。 **[Verified]** [1]。
- 2024年11月20日，公司荣膺高工锂电十五周年特别奖项——“十五年技术跃迁”。 **[Verified]** [1][3]。
- 2025年8月，公司取得一项名为“一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台”的实用新型专利授权（公告号CN224662069U）。 **[Verified]** [2]。
- 公司正在全面推进2026届校园招聘工作，开放机械、电气、工艺、机器视觉、图像算法及管理培训生等岗位。 **[Verified]** [3][5]。
